question: In rhombus \(ABCD\), \(\angle BAD=60^\circ\) and diagonal \(BD=5\). Find the perimeter of the rhombus.
solution: Since \(AB=AD\) and \(\angle BAD=60^\circ\), \(\triangle ABD\) is equilateral, so \(AB=BD=5\). The perimeter is \(4\times5=20\).
